summary: Three documented standalone binding gates fail outside OPAM despite being required as validated non-degraded gates
evidence: briefs/ocaml-functor-targets-qa-scope.md:20-23 documents direct rtk proxy node invocations. Observed exits were inventory=1, lifecycle=1, query=0 and compatibility=1; roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-native.js:38 masks the issue by running the modes through opam exec.
fix: Change the documented standalone commands to opam exec -- node or make the scripts establish the OPAM environment, then rerun all four modes successfully.
